materiality.rationale: Owner-delegated engineering caps frozen before paired Mortis diagnostic outputs: BOTH p50 <= OCR +1000ms and <=1.05*OCR; BOTH p95 <= OCR +2000ms and <=1.10*OCR, independently for PR/security and each declared stratum. Separate five-repetition OCR-only quiet-Docker calibration observed PR p50 20.180s (spread 0.327s), security p50 5.647s (spread 0.653s). Noise requires more independent paired evidence rather than wider margins; an additional 10s dispatcher tick is a meaningful regression. Calibration has only one visible family per workload and is not acceptance. No existing pilot ratio determined these caps.

bootstrap.minimum_families_source: Inherited from unchanged scripts/engine_eval/scoring_protocol.json bootstrap.minimum_families; repetitions are clustered by family_id

quality_rule: Unchanged: point precision/recall differences and one-sided 95% family lower bounds >= 0; undefined, no-event, tiny or degenerate samples are inconclusive; all confirmed high/critical defects preserved; unresolved judgments block acceptance.
latency_rule: For each declared controlled workload/graph/cache cell and percentile, bootstrap paired independent families. Per draw, both=max(absolute_excess_ms,relative_excess_ms), either=min(...); require one-sided 95% upper excess<=0 with adequate nondegenerate evidence. Live chosen-provider quality timings are descriptive only. Cells/percentiles never compensate; never subtract sums of overlapping provider calls.
consumption_rule: Freeze required request, total, input and output token counts; compare paired requests and total tokens, including all failures/retries. Preserve complete forwarded provider-event and durable ledger inventories: unfinished/unknown dispatch, inconsistent/missing token counts and unknown/reserved ledger usage block acceptance even when top-level totals look known. Optional invoice USD, cache and reasoning breakdowns remain descriptive unknowns when unreported; never replace them with zero or claim measured billing. Every declared finite cap additionally requires a known observable metric and remains enforced; the owner-selected current aggregate policy is explicitly uncapped, with no USD cap. Effective stage/resource/deadline limits remain bound separately by the frozen execution profile.
authorization: Prospective draft only. Numerical engine-overhead margins are predeclared from separate OCR-only calibration, not an acceptance result. Missing sample sizes, reviewer identities, fixture/profile hashes and heldout evidence still prevent freeze. No provider calls or public adoption authorized.
signoff_authority: Owner explicitly selected agent signoff. Fresh designated reviewers must be outside implementation and truth authoring, arm-blinded, and cover the entire packet through actual bound judgment documents. Never label agent review as human/external-expert review.

performance_measurement.limitations: External provider latency excluded by deterministic local responses and zero configured delay. Tiny local synthetic response processing, loopback round trips and observer overhead remain included; measured server wait is retained diagnostically, never subtracted from overlapping provider duration sums.

performance_fixture_rule: Separate visible truth-free performance plan, cases and paired schedule; no heldout quality truth enters performance workers. Freeze expected_work counts per case (findings, assessment_candidates, historical_verification_targets, source_files, security_analysis_tasks). Include clean/single-file cases and designated nonempty assessment/history/cross-file cases in each workload, with a security case larger than frozen analysis_concurrency. Validate each measured case against its own declared counts and retained outcomes/tasks; do not force clean cases to produce findings. Pin semantically equivalent arm-specific response fixtures and unchanged effective limits.
billing_limitation: This selected-provider prospective acceptance protocol rejects any nonnull aggregate_usd_cap because no observed invoice/billing binding exists; adding a numeric top-level cost claim cannot make such a cap enforceable. This is an evaluation-protocol limitation, not removal of production budget/cap features. Owner-selected aggregate request/token/USD caps remain explicitly null here; finite request/token limits and frozen per-stage/resource/deadline limits still fail closed on missing metrics or excess.
